title: Top End Wedding
tagline: Ten days to find Mum and get married.
about: A Darwin lawyer and her fiancé have ten days to find her missing mum before their wedding.
cue: Serve the pavlova when the wedding finally happens on the Tiwi Islands.
faces: Darwin mango and prawn rice paper rolls
Road trip damper with golden syrup butter
Lemon myrtle roast lamb for the wedding
COME IN OUT OF THE HEAT
Ten days, a wedding to plan and Mum's gone missing. At least there's barra on the barbie tonight. Typical, really.
Kids and dogs welcome on the verandah. Lauren and Ned flying to the Northern Territory. Prices subject to change. Licence 2019.

    StartersMindil Beach laksa cupsCoconut chicken laksa with tofu puffs, rice noodles and bean sproutsHow to make it3 tbsp laksa paste400ml coconut milk300g chicken thighs100g tofu puffs200g rice noodles150g bean sprouts500ml waterFry the laksa paste for 2 minutes, add the coconut milk and the water and simmer.Add the sliced chicken thighs and cook 8 minutes, then the tofu puffs.Divide the cooked rice noodles into bowls, ladle over the laksa and top with bean sprouts.Darwin mango and prawn rice paper rollsFresh rolls of prawn, mango, cucumber and rice vermicelliHow to make it100g rice vermicelli400g cooked prawns2 mangoes1 continental cucumber1 bunch mint1 bunch Vietnamese mint12 rice paper sheets3 tbsp fish sauce2 limes2 tbsp sugar1 red chilli1 garlic clove3 tbsp waterSoak the rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool.Peel and halve the cooked prawns.Slice the mangoes and the cucumber into strips.Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat, add prawns, mango, cucumber, noodles, mint and Vietnamese mint and roll tightly.Repeat until all the rolls are made.Mix the fish sauce, the lime juice, the sugar, the water, the chopped chilli and the garlic clove.Road trip damper with golden syrup butterLauren and Ned's road trip through the Top End to find her mumHow to make itAs written, serves 4Golden crusted damper with a soft, fluffy middle, torn hot and loaded with whipped golden syrup butter and a pinch of sea salt.Heat the oven to 200°C.Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour with 1 tsp salt.Stir in 300ml milk to a soft dough, knead lightly and shape into a round on a floured tray.Cut a deep cross on top, dust with flour and bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden and hollow sounding.Beat 125g soft butter with 3 tbsp golden syrup and flaky salt.Tear the damper hot and spread thickly.Chilli mud crab slidersTen days to the wedding. it720g barramundi fillets1 green mango1 bunch mint1 red chilli2 limes1 tbsp fish sauceScore the barramundi fillets and season.Grill skin down over high heat for 5 minutes, flip for 2.Toss the shredded green mango with mint, the sliced chilli, the juice of the limes and the fish sauce and pile on top.Lemon myrtle roast lamb for the weddingThe wedding on the Tiwi IslandsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb leg studded with garlic and rubbed with lemon myrtle and pepperberry, roasted pink over potatoes and pumpkin, carved for the whole family with salsa verde.Heat the oven to 200°C.Make 12 small cuts in a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves.Rub with 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp ground lemon myrtle, 1 tsp ground pepperberry and salt.Roast on 1kg potatoes and 800g pumpkin in chunks for 1 hour 20 minutes for medium.Rest 20 minutes.Blitz parsley, mint, 1 tbsp capers, 1 anchovy, lemon juice and 100ml olive oil into salsa verde.SweetsLauren and Ned's mango pavlovaCrisp meringue with whipped cream, mango and passionfruitHow to make it4 eggs220g caster sugar1 tsp cornflour1 tsp white vinegar300ml thickened cream2 mangoes3 passionfruitsWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, add the caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy, then fold in the cornflour and the vinegar.Shape a round and bake at 120°C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven.Top with the whipped cream, the sliced mangoes and the passionfruit.DrinksTop End frozen mango daiquiriFrozen mango, white rum and lime with a chilli salt rimHow to make it3 ripe mangoes160ml white rum4 limes40ml sugar syrupchilli flakes, to taste2 cups ice1 tbsp saltFreeze the flesh of the ripe mangoes in chunks for at least 2 hours.Mix the salt with a little chilli flakes, wet the rims of the glasses with lime and dip.Blend the frozen mango with the white rum, the lime juice, the sugar syrup and the ice until thick and slushy.Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel.For non-drinkers, leave out the rum and blend in a little
